summary:
Interim verdict: the OW-3 (b) fix works when I play it, but my test audit is not finished. The harness made me report while my mutant and suite runner was still going, so only one of its results was in.

What I saw: when a stay-home turn ends while the octopus is upstairs, it now stays where it is, awake, idle and visible, until the player goes down. That holds for a turn of this tab and for a turn finished in another tab inside the awake window. I reproduced the old behaviour on an untouched copy of a0483dd at 360x740 with touch:
- Own-tab turn: the octopus disappeared from the upstairs room for 12 frames in front of the player.
- Two-tab case: it disappeared for 33 frames, and the mirror showed '지금은 아래층에 있어.'
- On the fixed tree, both cases show 0 frames gone and 0 frames asleep upstairs.

Other checks on the fixed tree:
- Tapping the octopus upstairs shows the turn's line (bubble = APP.tapLine, data-tap 1).
- The mirror opens the sheet with no asks and no new log rows.
- The awake window does not count down upstairs (25000 ms both before and after about 9 s).
- On going down, the very first attic frame already has the octopus on the blanket (0.003 from the anchor), awake, with more than 15000 ms left. It then naps on the blanket.
- Climbing again during the window: it does not follow.
- Same results at 320x568.

Paths beyond the fix agent's checks:
- A salon ask upstairs during the window: the octopus walks to the mirror, the window stays frozen, going down puts it on the blanket, and it naps there.
- A new invitation from upstairs: the scene returns to the attic with the octopus on the blanket, and the next turn runs normally.
- A day change while upstairs, and a simulated 20-minute nap limit: on going down it is awake at its old attic spot, not asleep, and it follows again.
- The play room cannot be reached directly from the loft (goRoom returns 'far'), so that route does not exist.

The code review agrees with this:
- on.octUp is the single point every exit from the loft passes through.
- sleepNow now always puts a sleeping octopus on the blanket.
- The 2D fallback is unchanged by construction: octWithMe() is always false there, and the scene never emits octUp.
- No new player-facing text. The font check says stale: none, and no sound was requested or played (0 audio requests, 0 AudioContext).
- npm test on a copy: every sub-suite 0 failed.
- The fix agent's claim that docs/OWNER_DECISIONS.md has no 11-12 entries is true.
- No function of the gnits lane was touched, and scene3d.js is unchanged.

Not finished: my mutant runs and the five-in-a-row determinism runs. Only the first fixed-tree Z part 5 run had completed: 16 passed, 0 failed (575 s, load about 9). The rest of the queue (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/check-owner3/run.sh) had not reported when I had to stop. Its results, as far as it got, are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/check-owner3/logs/summary.txt.

Two findings so far, both about guards rather than behaviour:
- **should, unconfirmed:** I expect the `restPhase() !== 'up'` condition in on.octUp has no failing check, by reading the existing Z checks. Its mutant ran last in the queue and was not finished.
- **nit:** `|| octWithMe()` in sleepNow looks unreachable, so it has no failing check.

I found no defect in the behaviour itself.

problems.title: The 'only while resting' condition on the blanket placement has no failing check (expected; mutant run not finished)
problems.what: Without `restPhase() !== 'up'`, an ordinary awake octopus that followed the player upstairs would land on the blanket every time the player comes down, instead of its own spot. The only Z check about coming down (Z-1: `un.an !== 'salon'`, idle, hop 0) does not say which attic spot, and part 5 never reads the anchor after an awake octopus comes down. So this line looks unguarded.
problems.evidence: Read of tools/smoke.js around line 5393-5396 (Z-1 coming down) and all of Z part 5. Mutant /dev/shm/co3/muts/K1-octUpAlwaysBlanket.js was queued for a full Z run; its log will be /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/check-owner3/logs/mut-K1-octUpAlwaysBlanket.log, which had not finished when I reported. Unconfirmed until that run ends.
problems.suggested_fix: In Z-1 (or 5-a and 5-1, where an awake octopus that is not resting comes down), record the attic spot it is put on and assert it is its own spot (oct.anchor before climbing, or 'center' if that was 'salon'), not 'blanket'.

problems.title: `|| octWithMe()` in sleepNow seems unreachable and has no failing check
problems.what: Upstairs, roomNow() is 'loft', so watching() is false. lieDown then always calls sleepNow(t, true), so `place` is already true. The only call without place (after walkTo in lieDown) needs watching() to be true, and a resting octopus cannot climb (octResting). So the extra condition is defensive. Removing it should leave every check green.
problems.evidence: Code read of lieDown, watching and inPlay (app.js 1384-1397, 1350, 3799). Mutant /dev/shm/co3/muts/K2-sleepNoWithMe.js was queued for Z part 5; its result was not in when I reported.
problems.suggested_fix: Either keep it as a documented guard and say in the comment that it is defensive, or drop it. No player impact.

Guarding check: Z 5-3a/5-3b fail when the fix is reverted (fix agent's MA and ME); my reruns of those mutants were not finished.

Guarding check: 5-3c (fix agent's MB); my MB run not finished.

Item 2 outside the window and item 3 (never asleep upstairs): not reproduced as a separate bug on the base (the old code also moved it down). Guarding checks: 5-5d and 5-6 (fix agent's MF); my MF run not finished. In my probes I saw 0 frames asleep upstairs in every case (S, T, A, C, D, B).
Item 4 (mirror upstairs during the window): on the fix the sheet opens with 0 asks and 0 new rows; guarded by 5-3b.
Item 5 (tap line upstairs): on the fix the bubble equals APP.tapLine with data-tap 1; guarded by 5-3b.
